required_capability.title: Required Capability
required_capability.description: The capability an attacker needs to take this path: opportunistic, targeted or advanced. Set from the edge-kind table; the operator may edit it.

required_privilege.title: Required Privilege
required_privilege.description: The privilege an attacker must hold at the source to take this path: none, user, admin or system. Set from the edge-kind table; the operator may edit it.

granted_privilege.title: Granted Privilege
granted_privilege.description: The privilege an attacker holds at the target once the path is taken: none, user, admin or system. Set from the edge-kind table; the operator may edit it.

hidden_edge_kind.title: Hidden Edge Kind
hidden_edge_kind.description: The kind of inferred path this class records. Fixed.

technique_ids.title: Path Techniques
technique_ids.description: The ATT&CK techniques an attacker uses to take this path. Written by Dethereal from the accepted candidate; each becomes an exposure of the flow in category Inferred Path.

source_exposure_ids.title: Source Exposures
source_exposure_ids.description: The exposures the path was inferred from. Written by Dethereal from the accepted candidate.

proposed_by.title: Proposed By
proposed_by.description: rule: accepted as the hidden-edges module proposed it; operator: the operator edited it before accepting (its values may still be the module's, when only a rationale was added). Written by Dethereal.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: How firmly the model's facts support the path, as the hidden-edges module rated it: high, medium or low.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: The operator's own words on why the path holds, given when accepting. Empty unless the operator wrote one.
